description:
Corresponding genes of a Brassica gene in other genome assemblies: 32 Brassica assemblies distributed by BnaOmics: B. napus Darmor-bzh v10, Express 617, NY7, the eight HZAU genomes (Gangan, Zheyou 73, Shengli, Tapidor, Quinta, Westar, No2127; ZS11 is the BnIR genome) and the HZAU pan-genome reference, ZS11, Westar and Laurentian ONT assemblies, ZS4-2, ZS9, HTR001, Zhongyou 821 and ZS11 (FAFU); B. carinata zd-1; B. juncea AU213 and tumida v2; B. nigra YZ12151, Ni100 v2, C2; B. oleracea HDEM, JZS v2, Korso, OX-heart; B. rapa Chiifu v3.0 and v2.5, Z1 v2 (assembly ids like Bnapus_Darmor_v10, Bnapus_Westar_ONT, Brapa_Chiifu_v3; B. napus genes are matched to Ensembl Darmor v4.1, B. rapa to Chiifu, B. oleracea to TO1000, B. juncea and B. nigra to Ensembl B. juncea, B. carinata to B. juncea + B. oleracea); plus from BRAD (brassicadb.cn): the B. rapa pan-genome of Cai et al. 2021 (16 assemblies, ids Brapa_pan_<code>: CCA/CCB Chinese cabbage, CXA/CXB caixin, OIA oilseed, OIB/OIC rapid cycling, TUA/TUE turnip, PCA/PCB pak choi, WTC wutacai, TCA taicai, BRO broccoletto, MIZ mizuna, TBA Tibet), B. rapa Chiifu v4.1 (Brapa_Chiifu_v41) and pak choi (Brapa_PakChoi, genes only), radish Xiang (Rsativus_Xiang) and 15 wild Brassicaceae (Aethionema arabicum, Arabis alpina, A. halleri Tada, A. lyrata v2.1, Boechera retrofracta and stricta, Capsella grandiflora and rubella, Cardamine hirsuta, Descurainia sophia, Isatis indigotica, Leavenworthia alabamica, Sisymbrium irio, Thellungiella halophila, Thlaspi arvense; matched to Arabidopsis). gene: an Ensembl Plants gene
ID or name ('BnaC09g12820D', 'GSBRNA2T00000001001', 'Bra000001', 'Bo1g001000') or a gene ID of one of these assemblies (returns its Ensembl match, then the
other assemblies). Matches are DIAMOND best protein hits to the Ensembl gene (identity, query coverage, and
whether the pair is a reciprocal best hit); each gene has its location and a genome browser link. assembly
restricts to one assembly id; reciprocal_only keeps reciprocal best hits.
name: gene_in_assemblies
